Audit_Requirement: Verify that data sources, cleaning procedures, and data preparation steps are documented.
Review model configurations, training procedures, and evaluation results.
Verify that experiments, parameters, metrics, and model artifacts are recorded.
Review drift detection results and model performance monitoring reports.
Verify that identified risks, assessment scores, and mitigation measures are documented.
Review stakeholder impacts and proposed response measures.
Verify that incident scenarios and response procedures are documented.
Review governance principles, responsibilities, and applicable frameworks.
Verify deployment approval, authentication, and access control procedures.
